text:
noah: Hi all — I clicked the org invite but GitHub complains 'your account is not part of this organization' and asks me to enable 2FA. I already turned on 2FA and added recovery codes. Also I don't see infra-shared repo. Who owns repo access?

tara: Welcome Noah! Two quick things: 1) Do you have multiple GH accounts (work vs personal)? 2) Can you paste the exact error text or screenshot?

noah: It says: 'This organization requires two-factor authentication for all members. You do not have two-factor authentication enabled for noah-home.' I think the invite went to my work email but I'm signed in as a personal account in the browser.

morgan: That explains it — we send invites to the work account. Try signing out, signing into the work GitHub account, then accept. If you enabled 2FA on the work account but still see the message, sometimes SSO/SCIM provisioning lags.

noah: Signed out and back in to the work account (noah-rw). Now when I accept it redirects to 'Link your account to SSO' and errors with 'account_already_exists' — maybe I had a legacy invite.

infra-admin: Hey Noah, I can see two accounts associated with your email alias. I'll cancel both invites and re-invite the correct username. Can you confirm your GitHub username?

noah: Username is noah-rw. Thanks. Also I prefer SSH, but if you need PAT for CI I can do that later.

welcome-bot: Heads up: onboarding checklist — accept org invite, authorize SSO if prompted, enable 2FA on the account used, add SSH key or PAT, join eng-platform team. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding (internal).

infra-admin: Resent invite to noah-rw. After you accept, go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso to authorize SAML. I'll queue a team add for eng-platform with access to infra-shared and infra-config repos.

noah: Accepted and authorized SSO. I can see the org but infra-shared still not visible in the repo list.

morgan: That usually means you aren't in the team that has access. infra-shared is limited to eng-platform. Infra-admin, can you add Noah to eng-platform?

infra-admin: Added. Also granted read on infra-shared and write on infra-config per request. Try opening https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-shared directly.

noah: Can view the repo now. Cloned via SSH but `git push` failed with '403 remote: You do not have permission to push to this repository.' Looks like I only have read.

morgan: I gave the wrong ACL; updating to write now.

infra-admin: Updated permissions to write. If pushes still fail, check if you are using the correct SSH key and run `ssh -T git@github.com` to confirm the username reported.

noah: `ssh -T` returns 'Hi noah-rw! You've successfully authenticated'. Push worked after permission update. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

morgan: If you need CI token or Actions permissions, open a request with repo name and justification and we'll approve.

noah: Will do. Closing thread — onboarding checklist complete. Cheers! :tada:
